lines.text: Open the light? Turn it on!
Many learners say: Open the light, please.
Better: Turn on the light, please.
Turn on! Please turn on the light.

native.tip: En algunas zonas se dice “abrir la luz”, pero en inglés la luz se enciende: “turn on the light.”
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “Open the light, please.” En inglés la luz no se “abre”, se enciende: “Turn on the light, please.” ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “turn on”. Para encender luces o aparatos se usa “turn on”, nunca “open”. Escribe una frase tuya con “turn on” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: Some learners say “abrir la luz”, but in English you turn lights on: “turn on the light.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “Open the light, please.” In English you do not open a light, you turn it on: “Turn on the light, please.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
